scope: Second-host provider profile preparation and synthetic credential filesystem access
limits: This tests filesystem access under distinct Linux identities, not full credential/account confinement.
The trusted installer and host administrator remain able to access the profile.
Provider refresh, inference routing, live authentication and cleanup must be tested separately.
No private account identifiers, machine names, addresses or host paths are recorded.
authentication_evidence: Pre-login preparation only; later device authorization is a separate operation.
